name: Government data and factual place records
primary_finding: 17 USC105 excludes qualifying US Government works from US copyright; government possession alone does not establish public domain. Section102(b) excludes ideas/methods; raw facts and creative compilations differ. Federal exemption does not automatically apply to states, municipalities, contractors or Amtrak.
commercial_use: conditional on actual rights/provenance
redistribution: conditional; dataset notices/contracts and foreign rights need review
attribution: Statutory public-domain status alone no attribution licence obligation; agencies request credit; honour source-specific terms
recommendation: Track release-specific licence, author, contributors and date; licence photos/maps/logos separately
limitations: General research decision rule, not a blanket commercial clearance opinion.
evidence_status: primary legal/provider policy checked; implications are analysis

name: Buildings, artwork, photographs and logos
primary_finding: 17 USC120(a) permits pictorial representations of constructed architectural works located in or ordinarily visible from public places. It does not expressly grant blanket permission for3D model replication or separate sculpture/artwork. Names/short phrases are generally outside copyright; sufficiently creative logos/photos/artworks may be protected and trademark issues remain.
commercial_use: asset-specific clearance required
redistribution: asset-specific; factual inventory licence is not imagery/model licence
recommendation: Use facts and independently created permissible representations; record separate artwork/logo/photo/plan clearances; obtain legal review for detailed3D reproductions of protected works
limitations: Public access to a place or image does not itself convey reproduction rights. Avoid categorical freedom-of-panorama claims covering all public artwork.
evidence_status: primary legal/provider policy checked; implications are analysis
